claim: A generated intervention starts as a redundant bundle of components across four categories — tests, guards, instrumentation, and repair candidates — each covering some of the policy evidence a real finding requires. The workflow minimizes the bundle to the smallest subset that still covers every required evidence item, proves the minimized diff is 1-minimal (removing any remaining component drops coverage), and shows a real size reduction versus the full bundle while preserving full coverage and all four categories' contribution where applicable.
